issue_description.description: The audit was limited to Section 5.8 calculator behaviour, calculator heading links, and article-ending boundaries, as requested. The prior defect is resolved: entering 66.1 lb and switching to metric produces a valid 30 kg field, while entering 661.4 lb and switching to metric produces a valid 300 kg field. In both cases the result remains available and the Copy control remains enabled. Review of the canonical conversion state, active-unit validation bounds, shared heading-link enhancement, calculator page composition, shared ArticleEnding composition, PostNavigation boundary states, and article route integration found no concrete remaining defect in scope. The browser checks covered calculator controls and bounds, duplicate heading IDs, heading copy and direct-fragment behaviour, two-sided and one-sided post navigation, all article endings, long-form endings, and the calculator ending. No production mutation or external system was used.
issue_description.code_example:
Verification evidence:
1. `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/interactions.spec.ts tests/e2e/ui-parity.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep 'imperial boundary|UI-05 heading links|UI-12 restores|reopened article endings'` - Result: 4 passed. - Directly verified 66.1 lb -> 30 kg and 661.4 lb -> 300 kg, heading-link copy/fragment behaviour, article navigation boundaries, and the complete article-ending route matrix.
2. `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/calculator-supplement-comprehensive.spec.ts tests/e2e/calculator-responsive.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep 'calculator|bounded'` - Result: 17 passed. - Verified the calculator control matrix, accepted and rejected bounds, responsive containment, calculator guide self-link, duplicate IDs, direct fragments, and sharing behaviour.
